name: Nou o Taberareru Shiawase
source:
It was the "Season in Hell" that brought these two brilliant women together.

Hiiro Mifune, a student at the University of Tokyo, and Yuzuki Shirai, a student at the Tokyo University of the Arts, first met within the ranks of "Infini," a joint theater troupe comprising students from both universities.

As they rehearsed a romantic drama featuring literary giants as its protagonists, they grew increasingly intrigued by one another. Upon discovering that they both created art—one painting, the other writing poetry—they quickly grew close.

A polyamorous, complicated, and strictly temporary romance.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8326]Novelgame[/url]]
